title: UNESCO — Historic Fortified Town of Campeche

facts.fact: Campeche is on the Gulf of Mexico; the historic site combines a colonial harbour town and its defensive system.
facts.excerpt: on the coast of the Gulf of Mexico

facts.fact: The historic defensive wall incorporated eight bastions and four gates; building works ran1686–1704.
facts.excerpt: hexagonal wall, integrating eight bastions, four doors and walls

facts.fact: The urban plan had a main square facing the sea, with religious/government buildings.
facts.excerpt: with a Plaza Mayor facing the sea and surrounded by government and religious edifices
